en: Black‑and‑white image showing a uniformed mail carrier standing beside a bicycle in a residential urban area. He is sorting or holding a stack of letters next to a brick apartment building. The bicycle has bags or panniers for mail. In the background are other mid‑century apartment blocks, a pedestrian, and a lightly snowy or slushy ground, suggesting a cold climate.
